item.title: Zimbabwean teachers boosting English proficiency – education minister
item.description: The deployment of Zimbabwean teachers under a bilateral exchange programme is already yielding tangible results, particularly in improving English language proficiency among Rwandan students, according to Claudette Irere, the Minister of State for Education.

item.title: Police confirm two murder cases, one attempted murder in Bulawayo
item.description: Police in Bulawayo have confirmed two murder cases and one attempted murder that occurred in Bulawayo on separate occasions over the past two days.

item.title: Rising STI infections and repeat cases raise alarm in Bulawayo
item.description: Worrying levels of sexually transmitted infections (STIs), including a steady rise in new cases and a high number of repeat infections, are fuelling concern among health authorities in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe’s second-largest city, amid fears that the trend could reverse gains made in HIV prevention.

item.title: Zim’s life assurance sector shows growth but grapples with policy lapses and concentration risk
item.description: The life assurance sector in Zimbabwe recorded a significant increase in insurance revenue for the nine months to September 2025, but faces structural challenges including a heavy reliance on funeral policies, high rates of policies not taken up, and persistent lapses, according to the latest report from the Insurance and Pensions Commission (IPEC).

item.title: Restoring Hope, Integrity, and Personal Responsibility in a Weary Nation
item.description: Zimbabwe, like many nations, is experiencing a season of deep weariness. Many people are tired of promises, discouraged by unemployment and inflation, spiritually confused, emotionally drained, and increasingly cynical about leadership and the future. While economic challenges are real, the greatest crisis we face is not money first — it is a crisis of hope, values, and inner strength.

item.title: From vision to action: Zimbabwe launches its National Public Health Institute
item.description: Zimbabwe has taken a bold and historic step toward strengthening its health system with the creation of the National Public Health Institute (NPHI), aligned with global best practice and the African Union (AU) New Public Health Order.
